title: SolarCast Alert Event Schema
description: Schema definition for SolarCast Mode F1 solar energy deviation alert events.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the alert event

model_name.description: Name of the forecasting model producing the reference predictions

model_version.description: Version or tag of the forecasting model

window_start_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the first anomalous hour initiating the alert episode

window_end_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the latest anomalous hour in the episode

direction.description: Direction of deviation relative to expectation (negative for underproduction, positive for overproduction)

bin.description: Operating condition bin evaluated for the alert event

consecutive_hours.description: Number of consecutive hourly intervals outside calibrated bounds

mean_residual_kwh.description: Mean residual (actual - forecast) in kWh across anomalous hours in the episode

bound_low.description: Calibrated 1st percentile lower bound in kWh for the operating bin

bound_high.description: Calibrated 99th percentile upper bound in kWh for the operating bin

reason.description: Human-readable description of the alert trigger rationale

created_at_utc.description: Timestamp when the alert event record was generated
